name: URY admin filter bar
describe: Sticky report filter bar: date range trigger, branch select and an order-type multiselect with removable chips, on a bg-background/95 blurred strip with a bottom border and px 24 py 8.

Place directly under the report PageHeader. Built from the UryDateRangePicker trigger, SearchableSelect and MultiSelect class lists. Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Amount", the item, group, branch and breakup names and the sample dates are translated here because ar.csv has no usable entry. "# Orders" and "% of Total" are hard-coded English in the source and stay English. Header cells follow data-table.tsx (12px/500 text-tertiary).
